requirement: A slow VoiceStudio never ends the session for held speech, and a language rescue replays before live audio

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Review 19/10/2026: queue_overflow ended the session as provider; after a rescue live frames could reach the service ahead of the replay
oracle.invariant: S1: bounded memory, no provider failure, newest audio kept in order. S2: both phrases kept; ends stopped, settled false. S3: replay first, then live frames in order.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

assertionIds: VoiceStudio: speech while the server finishes a phrase is held within its bound; the session never fails for it
voice relay: a session on a slow VoiceStudio outlives a full hold, keeps both phrases, and ends unsettled — never as provider
a reopened session gets the replayed phrase before any live frame, also when audio waits for the service to start
